summary: A caller reported her mother's boyfriend held her down and took her phone before leaving on foot. A second caller told officers the woman was dressed in black and had threatened to stab the boy.
A caller reported a blue sedan had just been stolen from a parking area.
Officers were sent to a domestic disturbance in the 7000 block of Willis Avenue after a caller said her boyfriend had a gun.
A foot chase ended near Lincoln and Robinson streets, and Air 1 directed units to one person detained on the 1200 block of Lincoln Street.
Multiple callers reported smoke coming from an apartment window in the 3400 block of Wible Road. Truck 7, Truck 1 and two battalion companies were assigned to apartment 26.
Callers reported a muscle car doing burnouts in the roadway and illegal fireworks nearby.
Deputies were sent to 46th Street and Buford for a person in a black hoodie screaming, talking to herself and swinging a bat.
Crews responded to a second grass fire reported near Cottonwood and Bradshaw. Companies drove the area and could not find any fire.

A commercial building near 30th Street and Union Avenue caught fire before dawn. Crews found a loading dock involved and power lines down along one corner, set up a command post at 30th and Union and closed the northbound side of the road. Firefighters knocked the fire down outside and inside the building and reported the primary search clear.
Deputies checked South Granite Road near Round Mountain Road for a person in a blue tank top seen walking northbound who appeared disoriented.
Neighbors reported hearing a man and a woman arguing and banging on a wall at an apartment in the 6500 block of White Lane.
Officers and medics were sent to a welfare check for a man in crisis.
Commercial fire alarm at hotel on East Brundage.
Officers search for Nissan after pursuit in Arvin.
Semi truck driving wrong way with bright headlights.
Man found unresponsive on shoulder of Highway 58.
Vehicles blocking road after crash at 18th and H.
Vehicles stranded after crash at H and 18th.
Single-car crash with two injured on Mohawk Street.
